See how Epsilon powers connected marketing by unlocking the full potential of data and identity.

Overview

Epsilon is seeking a PhD Data Visualization Intern to join our Data Science Visual Analytics Team. As a Data Visualization Intern, you will be a vital team member in creating effective visualization tools that use marketing data to answer business questions in an engaging, intuitive and informative manner. Our visualization challenges span hundreds of millions of detailed profiles across hundreds of millions of websites and apps tied together by sophisticated real-time analytics that make near instantaneous decisions on messaging to those profiles billions of times a day. This provides an incredibly rich environment of business questions where answers are hidden within petabytes of data.

This is a hybrid role out of the listed locations and may also be offered remotely

Epsilon’s PhD Internship Program

As an intern, you’ll participate in a formal 12-week summer program developed to provide you with a comprehensive grasp of digital marketing and Epsilon’s personalization platform. During your internship, you’ll undertake a research project addressing a specific technology or business challenge, allowing you to apply your visualization expertise practically. Lastly, you’ll receive mentorship and feedback to help you successfully implement your research project.

Responsibilities

- Impact: Be at the core for creating innovative visualization systems that demonstrate the business value of Epsilon’s digital marketing platform directly to our collaborators and global customers, which includes some of the world’s largest brands.
- Career Growth: Improve your collaboration skills and acquire hands-on experience working on industry-level applications with large data sets and systems.

Qualifications

What you’ll bring with you:

- Currently enrolled in a PhD program with relevant coursework, research, and background in data visualization and/or visual analytics
- Proficient knowledge and practical exposure to data visualization concepts and software
- Ability to translate complex data sets into clear, visually compelling insights
- Demonstrated expertise in JavaScript or TypeScript development
- Hands-on experience with modern web technologies such as React, D3.js, WebGL, or Three.js

Why you might stand out from other talent:

- Ability to conduct independent research to identify and recommend the best approaches for solving complex technology and business problems
- Strong understanding of statistical analysis, data transformation, and analytics methodologies
- Familiarity with artificial intelligence concepts, including LLMs, agentic interfaces and RAG
- Hands-on experience applying UX/UI principles in real-world projects

Positioned at the center of Publicis Groupe, Epsilon helps brands deliver personalized experiences at scale and build lasting customer relationships by unlocking the full potential of data and identity. Epsilon operates in 30+ countries across EMEA, the Americas and APAC, with more than 8,000 employees.

Overview

NRDC (the Natural Resources Defense Council) works to safeguard the Earth, its people, its plants and animals, and the natural systems on which all life depends. NRDC combines the power of more than 3 million members and online activists with the expertise of some 800 policy advocates, lawyers, scientists, and communication experts to confront the climate crisis, protect nature, ensure the rights of all people to clean air, clean water, and healthy communities. As an international nonprofit environmental organization, NRDC is working to address the world’s most urgent environmental challenges, and advance innovative, science-based, and enforceable solutions.

Since our founding in 1970, NRDC has helped craft and deliver many of America’s foundational environmental laws, including the Clean Air Act, Clean Water Act and Safe Drinking Water Act. Today, we continue to lead in advancing and defending strong environmental protections at the local, state, federal and international levels, as well as through the marketplace. Our team works across the United States and around the world, from offices in Chicago, Los Angeles, New York City, San Francisco, and Washington, D.C., as well as in Beijing, and New Delhi (a subsidiary of NRDC India Pvt. Ltd.).

Supported by our members and online activists, NRDC is driving impactful solutions that confront the climate crisis, defend nature and safeguard public health across Asia, Africa, and the Americas. At NRDC, we believe lasting change happens when people bring their talent, passion, and expertise together for a common purpose: to build a cleaner, healthier, and more resilient world. Learn more at nrdc.org.

Our interns play an active role on the front lines of the environmental movement. Over the course of an internship, NRDC interns work with lawyers, scientists, or policy analysts in different program areas and amass experience that they could not have obtained anywhere else. Interns also have access to various events to enhance their NRDC experience.

- Research, data collection, and analysis

- Writing and developing materials for state and federal campaigns

- Supporting with designing equitable policy solutions

- Copywriting and editing social media posts and supporting on marketing campaigns

- Brainstorming opportunities for process improvements, new vendors, partnerships, and engagement

- Project management of department and team-wide initiatives

You can find examples of work by our interns on our Careers Page.

This oppportunity is based out of our Washington, DC office and interns are expected to be onsite 3 days per week.

The Knowledge Management Intern will develop knowledge management systems around scientific understandings of environmental challenges and solutions. The intern is expected to create a user-friendly system to maintain and update scientist-vetted talking points on various topics and develop guidance for interrogating scientific literature using approved AI tools (e.g., Copilot). The intern may produce scientific literature syntheses, compilations of internal scientific thinking and systems for vetting that thinking, agents for connecting AI search tools with existing tools, AI SOPS/prompts, and recommendations for institutional incorporation of AI into workflow. This student should have strong credentials in 1) science and 2) information systems or knowledge management.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills

- Able to collaborate, within a team

- Initiative, proactiveness, and creativity

Think probabilistically and then take action. “If you want to be certain, then you are apt to be obsolete.” Over-optimizing the components often degrades the system
